purpose.en: Music Bench: sheet music you can drill, with sound, and a 100-day plan. Each day is a short lesson and one drill of about ten minutes; go at your own pace or one day per date, with a streak that forgives a missed day. Pick a run of bars, loop it, and the score scrolls slowly under a fixed line while the notes play in time and the keys light up on a keyboard below. Press Hear it to hear the bars at full speed. The sound is a synthesized piano-like tone, not a recorded piano, and the app cannot hear you play. Open your own MusicXML file (.musicxml, .xml or .mxl) to add pieces. Nothing is sent anywhere.
